job.email_subject: Application: Senior Consultant SAP CX FSM / CS / CM
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

SAP CX projects need consultants who understand both the business process and the system behind it – that techno-functional role is my daily work at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Requirements, user stories, process mapping and UAT with business teams
– Resolved SAP ERP / MDM / Profisee integration bottlenecks
– 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) at Rockwell Automation and Shell
– Daily use of generative AI / LLM tools in analysis, coding and docs

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I am also an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User. My CV and cover letter are attached. Do you have time for a short call in the coming days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Senior Consultant SAP CX | SAP Commerce Cloud, Requirements & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP CX consultant with 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Bridges business and IT: requirements analysis, user stories, functional specifications, process mapping and UAT, followed by hands-on solution design and implementation. Delivers integrations between SAP Commerce, SAP ERP, MDM and PIM and supports customer processes in production. Works with international stakeholders in agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: BTC combines SAP consulting with deep industry processes – exactly where a techno-functional profile adds most. I want to bring five years of SAP Commerce Cloud, requirements engineering and SAP ERP integration into customer projects across the SAP CX portfolio, close to home in Baden-Württemberg. From Karlsruhe, with a valid work permit, I can start on 16 December 2026.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! Your Senior Consultant SAP CX role fits my profile: 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud, techno-functional (requirements, user stories, SAP ERP integration), double SAP-certified. Karlsruhe, start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Senior Consultant SAP CX FSM / CS / CM
en.hook: SAP CX service and commerce projects succeed when the consultant understands both the business process and the system behind it. That techno-functional role has been my daily work for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I translate business requirements into SAP Commerce Cloud solutions and integrate them with SAP ERP and MDM.

bullets.label: Requirements & process design
bullets.text: In a techno-functional role I analyse requirements with business stakeholders and product owners, write user stories and functional specifications, map processes, support UAT and translate it all into SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: SAP integration
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee, working directly with international technical teams; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP services and integrated external services via CCv2.

bullets.label: SAP CX solution delivery
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) with Java and Spring for product, catalog, pricing and customer data; developed and maintained Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Data across systems
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub that keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

en.logistics: With both SAP Commerce Cloud certifications (Developer and Business User) I bring the bridge between consulting and technology that your clients expect. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can strengthen BTC.
